sbt.tagline: Write what to do — Hermes will run it in the browser and show the steps
sbt.t_new_chat: New chat (clean feed, new Hermes session)
sbt.t_save_prompt: Save the current prompt as a skill
sb.memory_chip: from memory: assembled via knet, not from this chat
sb.ho_hint: take over the browser: finish it by hand, then press “Done, continue”
sb.ho_offline: ⚠ bridge offline — press again after it reconnects
sb.sk_saved_hint: saved · ↑↓ pick · Enter insert · Esc close
sb.sk_empty: empty for now: write a prompt and save it via “⋯”
sb.aud_tail: · showing the tail (the filter searches the whole file)
sb.chip_trash: I can find and clear the trash
sb.bridge_retry: bridge: reconnecting — the bridge address is not answering
sb.bridge_offline_hint: bridge: server unavailable — check the bridge (sk status) and the “Server” field in settings
sb.bridge_no_token: bridge: no token — open the add-on settings
sb.bridge_token_rejected: bridge: token rejected (rotation?) — refresh it in settings
sb.bridge_proto: bridge: protocol mismatch with the bridge
aud.via.silence: silence twice — block without a new ask
aud.title.preview_ok: Preview shown — the human did not object
aud.title.ho_wait: The agent is waiting for the human (hand-off)
aud.title.ho_replaced: Hand-off replaced by a new one
aud.title.ho_resume: The human continued — the agent is back
aud.title.ext_replaced: The previous extension connection was evicted by a new one
feed.shot_alt: what the agent saw at step {{n}}
cnt.hint_not_editable: target is not editable (tag={{tag}}, contenteditable={{ce}}); try the nearest input/textarea/contenteditable from page.dom, or click the field and use input with no target (focus); if it fails — handoff with an explicit reason
cnt.hint_beforeinput: the page cancelled beforeinput — the field has its own input script: click + per-character key, or handoff with a reason
cnt.hint_gone: the target vanished from the DOM after the click — state unknown, re-snapshot page.dom
cnt.hint_scroll: the window did not scroll (document is not scrollable) — for inner containers (feed/chat) take an element from page.dom and action:scroll with sid: it centers the target and scrolls its container
cnt.hint_nofocus: nothing editable in focus (activeElement={{el}}); first click the field (action:click), then input with no target; if it fails — handoff with a reason
err.tab_gone: tab_gone: the task tab was closed — ask the human in the chat, do not act on someone else's tab
err.tab_moved: tab_moved: the task tab moved to a different URL not by the agent — ask the human; tabs.use_tab {tabId, task} will rebind it
err.internal_page: internal_page: this is a browser internal page (about:, moz-extension:, devtools:), content.js is not injected there — work on http(s) or file
err.inject_failed: inject_failed: the auto-inject of content.js did not come up — reload the tab (Cmd+R) and repeat the request
err.no_metrics: no_metrics: clip is given in CSS pixels, the tab viewport metrics are unavailable
err.marks_unavailable: marks_unavailable: the tab's content script is not answering — heal the tab (page.dom/self-heal SK-18) and retry the shot
err.capture_bg: capture_unsupported_background_tab: this build has no tabs.captureTab — the window's active tab is available, a background tab is not
bg.warn_stop_offline: bridge offline — the agent was not notified
bg.notif_unavailable: browser.notifications is unavailable in this build
notif.test_msg: Seen and heard — the bell works. Click opens the sidebar.
opt.title: Hermes Sidekick — settings
opt.token_intro: Bridge session token. Take the contents of the file
opt.token_body: on the Hermes machine (one line, no newline) and paste it here. It is stored only locally in the extension; the value is never shown on the page.
opt.bell_body1: system notification with sound — the same path as the agent's bell (a valid icon from
opt.bell_body2: , no data: URIs). The sound comes from the operating system: WebExtensions has no audio API. On macOS —
opt.bell_macos: System Settings → Notifications → Firefox → “Allow Notifications” and “Sounds”
opt.bell_body3: . The task-done popup appears only when the Firefox window is not focused; permissions always ring.
opt.bell_hint_ff: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Notifications — the extension must not be in “Block”.
opt.bell_hint_macos1: macOS: System Settings → Notifications → Firefox → “Allow Notifications”.
opt.bell_hint_macos2: macOS: enable “Sounds” in the same place — the sound is macOS's, the extension has none.
opt.bell_hint_focus: You see nothing while the window is focused — that is by design for tasks: the bell badge and the journal. “Check bell” forces a popup.
opt.server_intro: WS address of the Hermes bridge.
opt.server_body1: — the ssh-tunnel mode, as before. To connect
opt.server_lan: over the local network without ssh
opt.server_body2: , set the address of the machine with the bridge, e.g.
opt.server_body3: ; the bridge must then listen on
opt.server_body4: (the bridge systemd unit). If the given address is unavailable, the extension falls back to localhost (tunnel) by itself, and retries ramp up exponentially from 2 to 60 seconds.
opt.server_warn: ws:// carries the token in clear text over the network — trusted home network only; for everything else keep the tunnel (empty field).
opt.tabs_body1: Agent tasks live in the tab group
opt.tabs_body2: (blue). What to do with the group after a task finishes:
opt.lang_intro: Interface language of the sidebar and settings. The agent's own texts are not translated.
opt.ph_token: paste a new token (hex from hub/token)
opt.no_token_hint: without a token the bridge will not let you in — paste the value from hub/token
opt.bad_hex: looks like the wrong thing got copied: a hex token of 64+ characters is needed
opt.check_noanswer: not connected — the extension did not answer the check
opt.bell_noanswer: the extension did not answer — the background page blinked, retry
opt.server_bad: need an address like ws://host-a.local:8791 (or wss://…)
opt.ws_only_warn: (heads-up: the bridge currently speaks ws:// only)
opt.reason_token_rejected: the bridge rejected the token (rotation?) — paste a fresh one
cap.action.do.scroll_top: scrolling the page to the top
cap.action.do.scroll_bottom: scrolling the page to the end
cap.action.do.hover: moving the cursor over the page
cap.action.do.move: moving the cursor across the page
cap.page.media: checking the video on the page
cap.page.active: checking what is open in front of me
cap.tabs.use_tab: binding the tab to the task
cap.terminal.command: 🖥 running a command in the terminal
cap.tool.web_extract.plain: 🌐 reading a page from the web
